subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate PR for the canonical Feishu binding issue lands?
rationale: The observable bug is real, but choosing between implicit Feishu peer inference, explicit peer syntax, or an account escape changes documented CLI input and persisted route bindings for existing users.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
options.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` semantics and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned recognizer that cannot silently steal account binds.

options.title: Accept Feishu-specific inference
options.body: Treat Feishu-looking values as peers only with explicit maintainer approval, upgrade notes, docs, and tests proving account-scoped setups remain expressible.

options.title: Pause this candidate and choose a sibling
options.body: Use one of the other open candidate PRs as the landing path if it better matches the desired compatibility contract and proof bar.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
recommendation.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` semantics and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned recognizer that cannot silently steal account binds.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans routing tiers, public CLI docs, and upgrade compatibility, and history shows adjacent routing work on the affected surface.
